name: smart-algos-trading-platform
description: Comprehensive algorithmic trading and investment solutions platform

scripts.build: cd client && npm install && npm run build && cd .. && node -e "const fs=require('fs'); const path=require('path'); const src='client/build'; const files=['index.html','manifest.json','asset-manifest.json']; files.forEach(f=>fs.copyFileSync(path.join(src,f),f)); const copyDir=(s,d)=>{fs.mkdirSync(d,{recursive:true}); fs.readdirSync(s,{withFileTypes:true}).forEach(e=>e.isDirectory()?copyDir(path.join(s,e.name),path.join(d,e.name)):fs.copyFileSync(path.join(s,e.name),path.join(d,e.name)))}; copyDir('client/build/static','static');"
scripts.build:client: cd client && npm install && npm run build
scripts.install:all: npm install && cd client && npm install
scripts.heroku-postbuild: cd client && npm install && npm run build

author: Smart Algos Team
